messages.text: I have not recieved my order but it says it was delivered
Sorry about that. Can you give me your order number, plus either the name it ships to or the postcode? I'll pull up the tracking and check whether it split into two packages.
Got it. What's the email on the order? That's the one detail I need to pull it up.
Handed to the team · Package marked delivered but not received; carrier trace / lost parcel claim nee

Thanks Ben. The Hammer Miner BC04 shows delivered September 26 in (address hidden), carrier ShipBob, tracking ····.

Worth a quick check first: any chance it was left with a neighbour, at a mailroom, or round the back? Delivery scans sometimes land a day before the parcel turns up.

Either way I've pinged the team to open a lost-package trace with the carrier. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here; if you step away, the answer comes to your email.
I have checked with my neighbors and nothing

Understood, so it's a genuine lost parcel. That's with the team now and they're on it in this chat; the trace goes to ShipBob and they'll sort the replacement or the claim from there.

One thing that helps: is the Oakland address a house, an apartment, or a building with a front desk? I'll add it to the trace so the carrier checks the right drop point.

Noted, apartment building. I've added that to the trace so they check the lobby and any parcel room scans, which is where these usually go astray.

Nothing else needed from you. Stay in the chat and someone from the team will pick it up here, and you'll get the outcome by email too.
Before you go, one thing: back on the 18th you ordered the Magic Miner 40T and cancelled it the same day, then went with the BC04. What changed your mind?
Makes sense, PG&E rates are brutal. Was it the monthly bill you were worried about, or something else, like heat or noise in the apartment?

Got it, that's useful to know. Thanks Ben.

The team has the lost parcel and will pick it up here shortly, and you'll get the outcome by email either way.
